info.title: Server API
info.description: REST surface of the server (attribute-routed controllers in Server/Controllers).

get.description: Whether Fleet:TerminalImage is present on the Docker daemon.

post.description: Pulls Fleet:TerminalImage from its registry. Running containers keep their image; restart a terminal to recreate it from the new one (its state volume is preserved).

get.description: Managed terminals; each entry merges the stored config and the live container state.

post.description: Registers the terminal and creates its Docker container from the terminals image (Fleet:TerminalImage) with the credentials injected as environment. start=true (or autoStart) also starts it. MetaTrader state persists on a named volume, so later container recreations lose nothing.

get.description: container.state is Missing until the container has been created; container.staleConfig flags a container older than the stored config (restart to apply).

put.description: Platform is immutable. An existing container keeps running with its old config (container.staleConfig=true); restart the terminal to recreate it with the new one.

delete.description: Removes the config, the container and (unless ?keepData=true) the MetaTrader state volume. Refuses while the container runs unless ?force=true.

post.description: Creates the container first when missing or stale (config changed while stopped), then starts it.
docker stop: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after Fleet:StopGraceSeconds.
Stops the container and recreates it from the current config when it is stale, so this is also how config updates are applied.

get.description: Last ?tail= lines (default 200, max 5000) of the container's stdout/stderr: Xvfb/x11vnc/wine startup and the entrypoint's provisioning output.
